text:
alina: Heads up — nightly e2e perf gate flagged a regression on the seq=128 scenario. perf-nightly is red. cc @sre-oncall @mike
perf-bot: perf-nightly failed (job #1865): p95 increased 120ms -> 212ms, throughput -18%. Full report: https://ci.internal/redwood/job/perf-nightly/1865
mike: Ugh. Any obvious suspect range?
alina: We see the delta between builds 1859..1864. Quick scan points at a change in batching heuristics (PR #482). Not 100% nailed down.
greg: Can we rerun 1865 with batching disabled and quantization off to check?
alina: Yep. Command to rerun below — it's the quick smoke for isolating batcher/quantize differences:
```
ci run --job perf-nightly --build 1865 --env 'BATCHER_ENABLED=false' --env 'QUANTIZE=none'
```
sre-oncall: Rerun queued, pinging build-bot to start.
build-bot: Re-run queued: https://ci.internal/queue/1870 — started by @sre-oncall
perf-bot: Rerun finished (job #1870): p95=122ms, throughput -2% vs baseline. Looks like disabling the batcher almost eliminates the spike.
alina: Ok that narrows it. Suspect: batching heuristic change introduced in PR #482. Can someone bisect 1860..1865? I'll try a quick local reproduce as well.
mike: I can take the bisect tomorrow AM. Which tool & args should I use?
alina: Use the internal perf-bisect tool. Example: `perf-bisect --start 1860 --end 1865 --test seq128 --repeat 5`
alina: Also here's a small failing log snippet from the failing run (1865):
```
[perf] seq=128 p95=212.4ms p50=23.1ms throughput=870 req/s
Model: rw-v1.3 quant=fp16 batcher=enabled
Trace: tail latency spikes at token 16-24
```
greg: Token-window spike around 16-24 — could be kernel selection fallback for longer KV windows, or batching coalesce causing weird scheduling.
mike: I'll start perf-bisect with `perf-bisect --start 1860 --end 1865 --parallel 4` and post updates. If it points at PR #482 we can try reverting or toggling the heuristic.
alina: Thanks. If anyone has bandwidth to try a quick local reproduce, run the same seq=128 configuration with `BATCHER_ENABLED=false` vs `true` and compare. If you find a fast repro, drop logs here.
greg: Adding @perf-eng to the thread for visibility.
mike: Will report back after bisect. :white_check_mark:
alina: :thumbsup:
